Database: solar
Task ID: solar_M_4

User Query:
Develop a PostgreSQL trigger function called generate_performance_alert that kicks in when new data entries are added. The function should monitor when a panel's performance does not meet its usual performance threshold (based on roughly 0.7\% degradation per year) and triggers Critical Performance Alerts according to our standard Alert Specification Protocol. Also, make sure that if similar alerts have been issued in the recent past, they are updated rather than creating duplicate records.

You have a budget of 18.0 bird-coins. Use your tools to explore the database, clarify ambiguities with the user, and submit your final SQL efficiently.
